precedence.cellSyntax: Layer raw cell is exactly one complete bold span; compare its content and Owns/Home after trimming outer ASCII whitespace and unwrapping only complete inline code spans; preserve case, punctuation and internal whitespace and apply no other Markdown or prose normalization
precedence.application: every Layer, Owns and Home cell must equal its row literal; mixed-family or unrecognized Owns prose invalidates the table; rows 1 through 5 are exact normalized roots, row 6 expands roster/{butler}/ only for a declared roster key, and row 7 is inert because code owns no admitted fact; an applied expanded home must contain at least one admitted source; the unique lowest-numbered applied home assigned by factFamilyRows selects its declaration; the root summary is non-owning; malformed, duplicate, missing, equally ranked or mutually disagreeing rules select nothing

resourceLimitSemantics.maxSources: the complete revision-bound manifest; an excess preserves every tree-known source identity but admits no source body and makes every dependent fact Unknown
resourceLimitSemantics.maxBytesPerSource: the exact UTF-8 blob before classification or parsing; the limit plus one byte is never passed to an extractor
resourceLimitSemantics.maxTotalBytes: one cumulative counter across phase A and phase B; count each repository-relative-path plus object-id body once and never reset between phases
resourceLimitSemantics.maxParsePassesPerSource: one unit is one complete traversal of one decoded source by a pass in parsePassIdentities; a helper traversal is charged to its named caller pass, repeating a pass counts again, and an unregistered traversal is forbidden; elapsed wall-clock time is not an input
resourceLimitSemantics.maxHumanResponseBytes: the final encoded HTTP body for each Polaris HTML response
resourceLimitSemantics.maxMachineResponseBytes: the final encoded HTTP body for each authenticated Polaris machine JSON response
resourceLimitSemantics.maxBriefingResponseBytes: the final encoded HTTP body for each authenticated derived read-only machine view response whose required subject is one exact project-shape claim identified by its full claim id and whose remaining fields are same-evaluation joins independently derivable from the machine answer already served under maxMachineResponseBytes; it is a separate and tighter ceiling, never a share of that one, and a view without its own declared ceiling is not served
resourceLimitSemantics.breachResult: source and input breaches retain the complete population and make dependent facts Unknown; final-output breaches emit only a bounded typed failure carrying evaluation identity, limit identity, declared value, observed value and population counts; no truncated or success-shaped model is emitted; PWB-REQ-021 readiness is false

currencyBoundSemantics.measuredFrom: one row declares the maximum age of the evidence behind a claim of that class, measured from the committer instant of the exact Git object the declaration was extracted from
currencyBoundSemantics.measuredTo: the age is computed to the evaluation's own as-of instant and to no other coordinate; the judge reads no wall clock, so two runs of one identified evaluation agree on every freshness state, and the passage of time changes a claim only through a new identified evaluation
currencyBoundSemantics.claimClassAssignment: every claim is named by its full claim id, because two populations differ only by an infix: each of the nine extraction-class rows governs the claim:item:<class>:<declared-key> claims of that class, that class's own claim:class:<class> aggregate, and the claim:fact:item:<class>:<key> item-identity twin of its claim:item: claims, which carries the identical reconciled item under a second claim-id infix and so takes that same row's bound; project-fact-declaration governs the three remaining closed fact families claim:fact:count:<class>, claim:fact:catalog-count:<catalog-key> and claim:fact:project-account:<key>; project-account-statement governs the six statement claims claim:project-account:<key>, which carry no fact: infix and are a different population from the claim:fact:project-account:<key> family above; source-coverage governs one admitted source, claim:source:<repository-relative path>; and project-shape governs the single whole-shape aggregate claim:project-shape
currencyBoundSemantics.undeclaredClass: a claim whose class has no row here never leaves Unknown: the judge returns its no-bound-declared arm and the claim renders Unknown with the closed reason no-currency-bound-declared; this array is the only place a bound is declared and an implementation constant, default or fallback bound repairs nothing
currencyBoundSemantics.outOfBoundResult: evidence older than its class's bound at the as-of instant, evidence whose instant cannot be read, and evidence dated after the as-of instant all render Unknown with the closed reason stale-beyond-currency-bound and a distinct machine-readable basis; none of the three supports a current or favourable answer
currencyBoundSemantics.outsideTheseBounds: these rows cover project-shape claims only; a disclosed fact of the render that carries no freshness value is not a claim class, takes no row here, and acquires no bound by default
currencyBoundSemantics.boundChange: a value in this array is declared by an exact owner act over this entry and by nothing else; no implementation may mint, widen, narrow or default one, and a bound present in the tree without an effective owner act does not unblock its class
